2610.08095.title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
2610.08095.paper_summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.
2610.08095.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言訪問 RDF 知識圖譜是語義網的核心抱負。大型語言模型 (LLMs) 已經推進了文本到 SPARQL 的技術，但在不熟悉的圖譜上，它們經常生成有效的查詢，卻錯誤地表述了填充的數據模型。QRAKEN 是一個無需訓練的、與本體無關的神經符號管道，將生成基於實證圖證據而非架構期望。離線蒸餾器生成 TTQL，這是一種對填充的多跳模式、條件頻率和路徑條件文字示例的緊湊描述，還包括一個類-屬性共現矩陣。在線上，TTQL 指導 LLM，同時確定性語法、詞彙和數據模型檢查提供了迭代改進的診斷。在 CK25（第一屆國際 Text2SPARQL 挑戰）中，在 QLever 快照下的匹配條件重新計算中，QRAKEN 以 GPT-4.1 mini 達到 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 的嚴格 F1，並以 GPT-5.4 達到 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012：相對於最強重新計算參與者的增益分別為 30% 和 32%，超越了使用相同基礎模型系列的系統。消融實驗確定 TTQL 模式是主要驅動因素（相對於僅形狀基線提高 +0.31 嚴格 F1）；改進迴圈提供了一個廉價的安全網，拒絕共現矩陣不支持的三元模式。與自動導出的 SHACL 相比，TTQL 產生 64% 更高的嚴格 F1，支持實證模式超越架構暴露的價值。使用兩個本地 35B 4-bit 開放權重模型，邊際成本為零，該管道與最強的重新計算參與者相匹配，且 TTQL 相對於僅形狀和 SHACL 基線的優勢持續存在。在單一的、相對較小的基準上，結果提供了初步的實證信號；在非常開放的跨域圖譜上進行單體 TTQL 注入仍然是主要的限制。
